title: Pan-Seared Snapper with Venezuelan Seasoning
description: A flavorful and crispy snapper dish inspired by Venezuelan cuisine. This recipe is perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Rinse the snapper fillets and pat them dry with paper towels.
Season the snapper with salt, black pepper, and venezuelan seasoning.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the snapper for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until it develops a nice crust.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the snapper is cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and serve the snapper hot with a squeeze of lemon juice.
Garnish with crispy garlic powder and naturally smoked paprika, if desired.
